binding_revisions_to_9B: For externally grounded answers, _answer_evidence must include only trusted evidence of explicitly required source types; a single required type may retain multiple candidates, and course evidence is included only when course is explicitly required.
The attempt-1 ValidationError is not evidence of a schema defect. Keep backend/llm/schemas.py unchanged, fail closed, never accept attempt 0, and persist only bounded loc/type diagnostics.
Paper authors must come from the structured authors field, not inferred text; standard status is restricted to an explicit raw_metadata allowlist; existing NVD mapping remains unchanged.
New server responses must always populate Citation.source_id even though the response field remains optional for legacy object compatibility.

backend/agent/orchestrator.py: private bounded sanitization and diagnostic helpers used only by those functions
backend/schemas.py: Citation.source_id additive legacy-compatible response field only
frontend/pages/student.py: _render_citations source label and legacy fallback only

auth/RBAC, course authorization, and teacher course scope
